the students who participated in this research have a positive attitude towards the use of social media in education and they are ready for the change.
the students’ learning is enhanced by the social interaction and collaboration that the online environment offers.

the question of whether the connectivist approach to learning is an effective way to teach and learn.

how the use of technology and online environments can support the development of a more connectivist approach to learning, and how this approach can be supported in a more traditional learning environment.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Connectivism is a learning theory for the digital age and it is the theory that explains the way we learn today and in the future, in the digital age.
connectivism is a learning theory for the digital age, and it is the most appropriate learning theory for online learning.

the learning process is not only about acquiring information and skills but also about developing the ability of the learner to use and create connections between different information, knowledge and skills, to be able to solve problems, to create new knowledge and skills and to be able to use the acquired knowledge in the future.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have to be open for change, be flexible and ready for the future.
we have to be open to the new ways of learning and we should not forget the old ways of learning, because they still have their value in the process.
the learning process is a social activity, which takes place in a community of learners, where people share their knowledge and experience, and where they are able to create new ideas.

we need a new theory of learning to account for the new learning environments that technology has enabled us to create.
we can learn to be more creative by using our brains differently, in a more flexible way, and by using the brain's natural ability to learn.
